<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text

```

Logical OR.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented (SQL syntax) |
| Group | `predicate_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT true or false;
```

Result:

```text
true
```

```sql
SELECT false or false;
```

Result:

```text
false
```

```sql
SELECT true or NULL;
```

Result:

```text
true
```

```sql
SELECT false or NULL;
```

Result:

```text
NULL
```
